numerical_parity.note: Requires held-out corpus open-loop chunk parity and same-observation shadow compares that cover every fresh action-chunk inference. Cached queued-action traces are not numerical export evidence.

closed_loop_task_outcomes.note: Requires completed baseline rollouts with recorded success/terminated/truncated fields. Two-seed results are a smoke check, not statistical evidence of performance equivalence.

independent_trajectory.note: Independent-rollout action equality and identical episode lengths are diagnostics only; they are not numerical export requirements.

export_validation.note: schema_version=2: deployment passed requires same-input numerical parity and completed closed-loop task outcomes with recorded fields. Independent trajectory similarity is diagnostic only.

image_degrade.quantization_note: JPEG quality is a codec quality parameter, not a bitrate. Optional bandwidth estimates use measured JPEG payload bytes only.

provenance.success_semantics: Success when reward==4 (left gripper holds cube off table). Obs: observation.images.top (3,480,640), observation.state (14). Action chunk 100; n_obs_steps 1; MEAN_STD norms.
